visualCharacteristics.purpose: Product range teasers in a horizontal slider
visualCharacteristics.description: Product cards (square image, bold uppercase name, description). 4 visible from 768px with square Previous/Next buttons; 2.5 visible on mobile with swipe scrolling and dash dots. Controls hide when every card fits.
visualCharacteristics.source: Industry pages: .industries-product-slider (slick, 4 slides, 2.5 below 768px with dots).

contentPattern.structure: One row per product: image | bold name paragraph + description

reuseGuidance: Use for any number of look-alike product cards that should scroll horizontally. For a static grid use cards-industry or cards-news.
